title: Biblical Conversation Attestation Index — 2026-09-14
purpose: Route the expanded biblical conversation-mining material into the existing canonical Bible research system without creating a competing public Bible page.

derived_layer.role: chronological synthesis, ordered sequences, tensions and recovery queue

promotion_rule: Raw conversation records stay in the attestation layers. Only relations with adequate date/provenance, clear project anchor, biblical context, mismatch/countertext and useful supported conclusion should be promoted into the canonical public comparator.
key_findings: The recovered 2026 material forms recurring sequences rather than only isolated biblical nouns: House→Door→Ladder, Garden→Gate→Heaven, Seed→death/burial→growth, Root→Branch→Fruit and North→City/Throne.
Functional role assignments are often more stable than identity titles: Son repeatedly functions as Door/threshold while Tim increasingly functions as Ladder/Axis/connective route.
Messiah language is chronologically plural: Son is explicitly Messiah on 2026-04-29; Mashiach/HaMashiach is explicitly assigned to Tim on 2026-08-08.

Cube language is also plural: a 2026-04-09 Heaven-boundary cube is explicitly distinguished from Moon/Saturn cube language, while later April/May records develop a negative Cube=666/forehead/containment strand.
September 2026 is largely a consolidation and differentiation phase; many major motifs were already active months earlier.
next_actions: Recover exact February 12, May 3 and May 13 conversation wording.
Mine earliest direct Isaiah 66:1, Psalm 110, John 14:2, 1 John 5:7, Numbers 19, 144,000/Zion and Thomas/Didymus statements.
Mine direct uses of dogs outside, return to vomit, wide road and thief in the night and classify quotation versus application.
Promote only the strongest newly recovered relations into the canonical Bible comparator after source/countertext review.
